headline_seed: Trump and officials 'likely' targets of press dinner shooting suspect, authorities believe
description_seed: The suspect is expected to be charged with assault of a federal officer and using a firearm during a crime of violence, officials have said.

what: Trump and officials 'likely' targets of press dinner shooting suspect, authorities believe

clean_source_blocks.text: The suspect is expected to be charged with assault of a federal officer and using a firearm during a crime of violence, officials have said.

US President Donald Trump and his officials were the "likely" targets of a suspected gunman who attempted to storm the White House Correspondents' Dinner, acting US Attorney General Todd Blanche has said.

Trump shooting LIVE updates: The gunman who attempted to breach the ballroom at the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner was likely targeting members of the Trump administration, Acting US Attorney General Todd Blanche said on Sunday. US President Donald Trump was evacuated and is “not injured” after multiple shots were fired during the White House correspondents' dinner on Saturday night. In his first remarks after the security incident, the US president stated that he, First Lady Melania Trump, Vice President JD Vance and other cabinet members were safe....Read More
Officials said law enforcement exchanged fire with the alleged attacker and intercepted him, and "believe" the suspect fired his weapon. He was not struck, but was taken to hospital for evaluation.
